topic: Fundamentals of Vectors: The Language of Space

sections.title: Introduction: What is a Vector?
lecture_lines: Vectors possess both magnitude and direction.
Scalars are represented by single numbers.
Think of vectors as directed paths.
animations: Create a point P at (2, 3) and label it 'V'. Color P in #FFFFFF.
Draw a vector from origin (0,0) to point P. Color in #FF5733.
Display the label 'Vector V' near the vector. Color in #FF5733.
Animate the vector pulsing to emphasize its magnitude. Use a ruler to measure the length: [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/ruler.svg].
Highlight the origin and point P in #FFFF00 using a compass to mark the rotation: [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/compass.svg].

sections.title: Visualizing Vectors in 2D Space
lecture_lines: Vectors are arrows on a plane.
Each starts at the origin point.
animations: Display a grid on the screen in #333333.
Draw vector V = [3, 2] starting from origin. Color in #3498DB. [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/none.svg]
Label the components (3, 2) next to the vector. Color in #3498DB.

sections.title: Vector Addition: The Tip-to-Tail Rule
lecture_lines: Place second tail at first tip.
Resultant is the path's total displacement.
animations: Show vector A = [2, 1] starting from origin in #2ECC71, accompanied by a [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/compass.svg] to indicate direction.
Show vector B = [1, 3] starting at the tip of A. Color in #F1C40F.
Draw the resultant vector A+B from origin to tip of B in #FFFFFF, using a [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/ruler.svg] to measure the final magnitude.

sections.title: Scalar Multiplication: Stretching and Flipping
animations: Draw vector V = [1, 2] in #E74C3C using [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/ruler.svg] for precision.
Scale vector by 2 to length [2, 4] in #E74C3C.
Scale vector by -1 to direction [-1, -2] in #9B59B6 using [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/ruler.svg] to mark the new distance.
